cities.name: Luxembourg City

interests.name: Old Town Culture 🎭
interests.description: Luxembourg’s Old Town is a UNESCO-listed blend of medieval streets, grand palaces, and elegant squares. Great for slow walks, cafés, and architecture lovers.

interests.name: Fortress Views 🏰
interests.description: The Corniche and fortress walls offer some of Europe’s most dramatic viewpoints — cliffs, walls, valleys and historic fortifications.

interests.name: Parks & Nature 🌿
interests.description: The lush Pétrusse Valley cuts through the city, offering peaceful escapes, walking paths, and beautiful greenery.

interests.name: Riverside Walks 🌊
interests.description: The Grund district along the Alzette River is one of the most picturesque neighborhoods — perfect for sunsets, cafés and quiet walks.

interests.name: Local Food Exploration 😋
interests.description: Luxembourgish cuisine blends French and German influences — expect potato dishes, soups, pastries and cozy cafés across the central squares.

cities.local_food_tip: Luxembourgish potato dishes, soups, fresh breads, salads and pastries — jednostavno i preukusno.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Grand Ducal Palace (exterior) → walk along The Corniche for incredible views → coffee in the Grund. Afternoon: Walk through Pétrusse Valley → lunch near the city center → view the exterior of MUDAM Art Museum → walk by the Alzette riverside. Sunset: Fortress-wall viewpoints near Bock Casemates. Night: Dessert cafés + night reflections in the Grund.

places.name: Grand Ducal Palace
places.description: The official residence of Luxembourg’s Grand Duke — elegant Renaissance façade and a central Old Town landmark.

places.name: The Corniche
places.description: Called 'the most beautiful balcony of Europe' — dramatic views over the valley and fortifications.

places.name: Bock Casemates
places.description: Historic underground tunnels carved into the rock — part of the old fortress system.

places.name: Pétrusse Valley
places.description: A beautiful green valley with walking paths, bridges and city views from below.

places.name: MUDAM Luxembourg
places.description: Modern art museum with sleek architecture and exhibitions.

places.name: Grund District
places.description: A charming riverside village-feel neighborhood in the lower part of the city.

hidden_gems.name: Chemin de la Corniche Lower Path
hidden_gems.description: A quieter, lower-level path beneath the main Corniche walkway — peaceful and scenic.

hidden_gems.name: Neumünster Abbey Courtyard
hidden_gems.description: A cultural center in a historic abbey by the river — calm courtyards and beautiful architecture.

hidden_gems.name: Pfaffenthal Panoramic Elevator
hidden_gems.description: A free glass elevator offering panoramic city views — especially stunning at sunset.

ideas: 🚶 Old Town strolls near Grand Ducal Palace.
🍦 Ice cream by the river in the Grund.
🍁 Red and gold tones across Pétrusse Valley.
🍫 Hot chocolate in Old Town cafés.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚋 All public transport in Luxembourg is free — buses, trams and trains.
🚆 CFL trains connect the whole country quickly and comfortably.
🚶 Old Town and the Grund are fully walkable.
📱 Use the Mobiliteit app for routes, real-time departures and planning.

city_events.name: Luxembourg Light Festival
city_events.description: ✨ Illuminated streets and large artistic light installations across the Old Town.

cities.name: Differdange
cities.local_food_tip: Simple hearty meals: soups, potatoes, salads and pastries.
cities.full_day:

cities.name: Differdange

interests.name: Urban Culture 🎭
interests.description: Differdange has a compact urban center with calm pedestrian streets, local culture, and small artistic corners.

interests.name: Parks & Green Spaces 🌿
interests.description: Parc Gerlache is one of the town’s most relaxing green areas with shaded paths and quiet viewpoints.

interests.name: Calm Small-Town Walks 🚶
interests.description: Differdange is known for peaceful walks through residential streets, local cafés, and gentle hills.

cities.local_food_tip: Simple hearty meals: soups, potatoes, salads and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk around the town center → stop for coffee in a local café. Afternoon: Relax in Parc Gerlache → enjoy a light veggie lunch → explore small exterior art corners near Parc des Sports. Sunset: Soft golden light from Fousbann viewpoint area. Night: Quiet stroll through town streets + dessert.

places.name: Differdange Town Hall
places.description: Central landmark of Differdange, surrounded by cafés and calm pedestrian streets.

places.name: Parc Gerlache
places.description: A quiet park with forested corners, benches, and pleasant walking routes.

places.name: Parc des Sports
places.description: Large open area for walks, sports, and relaxing afternoons.

places.name: 136°5 Creative Hub
places.description: A modern cultural and design space representing Differdange's artistic community.

places.name: Fousbann Quarter
places.description: Hilly neighborhood offering peaceful viewpoints and evening walks.

hidden_gems.name: Old Railway Path
hidden_gems.description: A quiet walking route starting near the station — great for slow peaceful strolls.

hidden_gems.name: Gradin Park Steps
hidden_gems.description: Small stairways tucked into the green areas of Parc Gerlache — perfect for photography.

hidden_gems.name: Creative Street Pop-Ups
hidden_gems.description: Occasional mini-art installations around the creative district near the town center.

ideas: 🎨 Small art spots near 136°5 Creative Hub.
🍫 Hot cocoa at cafés near the center.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 All local buses are free across Luxembourg, including Differdange.
🚆 Direct rail connection to Luxembourg City in 25–30 minutes.
🚶 The town center is compact and walkable.
📱 Mobiliteit app gives real-time bus & train info.

cities.name: Echternach

interests.name: Lakes 🌊
interests.description: Echternach Lake is a peaceful recreation area with long walking paths, open views and calm lakeside cafés.

interests.name: Nature Trails 🌿
interests.description: The Mullerthal region, known as Luxembourg’s 'Little Switzerland', offers forest trails, viewpoints and rock formations.

interests.name: Old Town 🎭
interests.description: Echternach’s Old Town features narrow streets, historic squares, cafés and a peaceful medieval atmosphere.

cities.local_food_tip: Soups, salads, breads and simple local veggie meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk around Echternach Lake → coffee at a lakeside café. Afternoon: Explore viewpoints of the Mullerthal region (exterior) → enjoy a light lunch → walk into Echternach Old Town. Sunset: Watch the colors over the lake. Night: Cozy stroll through the Old Town lights.

places.name: Echternach Lake
places.description: A beautiful recreational lake perfect for walking, relaxing and photography.

places.name: Mullerthal Region
places.description: Luxembourg’s famous natural area with forest trails and scenic viewpoints.

places.name: Echternach Old Town
places.description: Medieval center with narrow streets, cafés, and historic architecture.

places.name: Echternach Abbey
places.description: One of Luxembourg’s most important historical and religious landmarks.

places.name: Basilica of St. Willibrord
places.description: A stunning basilica dedicated to the city’s patron, known for its unique procession tradition.

hidden_gems.name: Wolfsschlucht (Wolf's Gorge)
hidden_gems.description: A dramatic narrow gorge in the Mullerthal with moss-covered rocks and magical forest atmosphere.

hidden_gems.name: Wollefsschlucht Viewpoint Trail
hidden_gems.description: A peaceful walking area above the gorge offering quiet scenic viewpoints.

hidden_gems.name: Small Riverside Walk
hidden_gems.description: A serene short riverside trail along the Sûre River.

ideas: 🍫 Hot cocoa inside cafés in the Old Town.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Free regional buses connect Echternach with Luxembourg City and nearby towns.
🚶 The lake and Old Town are fully walkable.
📱 Mobiliteit app provides real-time routes & bus schedules.

city_events.name: Echternach Spring Procession
city_events.description: 🎵 UNESCO-listed traditional procession unique to Echternach.

cities.name: Esch-sur-Alzette

interests.name: Urban Culture 🎭
interests.description: Esch-sur-Alzette is Luxembourg’s second largest city, known for its multicultural character, vibrant streets, cafés, and artistic identity.

interests.name: Art & Museums 🎨
interests.description: The city is home to modern art spaces, industrial heritage museums, and the impressive cultural transformation of the Belval district.

interests.name: Parks 🌿
interests.description: Green parks and hillside viewpoints give Esch a calm and surprisingly natural atmosphere, perfect for walks and relaxing afternoons.

cities.local_food_tip: Light veggie meals: soups, salads, breads and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore the Esch-sur-Alzette city center → enjoy a café in the pedestrian zone. Afternoon: Head to the ultra-modern Belval district for architecture views → have a light veggie lunch → relax at Gaalgebierg Park. Sunset: Enjoy golden-hour views around Belval. Night: Walk through the illuminated modern district and its cafés.

places.name: Esch City Center
places.description: A lively center filled with shops, cafés, and multicultural atmosphere.

places.name: Belval District
places.description: A major redevelopment zone with modern architecture, university buildings, and striking industrial towers.

places.name: Blast Furnaces Belval
places.description: Two restored steel blast furnaces transformed into a museum and viewpoint — a spectacular look into Luxembourg’s industrial past.

places.name: National Museum of the Resistance
places.description: An important museum dedicated to WWII history and Luxembourg’s resistance movement.

places.name: Parc du Gaalgebierg
places.description: A hilltop park with gardens, trails, and peaceful city views.

hidden_gems.name: Belval Panorama Walkway
hidden_gems.description: A lesser-known elevated walkway offering impressive views over the steel towers and modern district.

hidden_gems.name: Cultural Square (Place des Hauts Fourneaux)
hidden_gems.description: A quiet cultural plaza between industrial monuments and futuristic architecture.

hidden_gems.name: Gaalgebierg Rock Gardens
hidden_gems.description: Hidden among the park’s paths — peaceful rock gardens and forest corners ideal for calm moments.

ideas: 🌇 Modern sunsets among the blast furnaces.
🎨 Gallery visits in the cultural district.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚆 Direct trains connect Esch-sur-Alzette to Luxembourg City frequently.
🚌 Local and regional buses are free throughout Luxembourg.
🚶 Many parts of the city center and Belval are walkable.
📱 Mobiliteit app provides live schedules and route planning.

cities.name: Ettelbruck

interests.name: Riverside 🌊
interests.description: Ettelbruck sits at the meeting of Sauer and Alzette rivers, offering peaceful riverside walks and calm natural corners.

interests.name: Nature 🌿
interests.description: The town is surrounded by gentle hills, parks, and quiet green areas ideal for walking, relaxing, and enjoying fresh air.

interests.name: Calm Streets 🎭
interests.description: A small, peaceful center with local cafés, bakeries, and simple Luxembourgish town charm.

cities.local_food_tip: Warm soups, salads, breads and pastries — jednostavno i fino.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start with a walk along the Sauer Riverside → enjoy coffee in the center. Afternoon: Relax in Parc Halen → veggie lunch nearby → explore old streets of Ettelbruck. Sunset: Peaceful colors along the riverside. Night: Quiet town lights and dessert cafés.

places.name: Sauer Riverside
places.description: A peaceful walking path along the Sauer River, ideal for morning and sunset walks.

places.name: Parc Halen
places.description: A calm central park with trees, grass areas, and relaxing walking routes.

places.name: Ettelbruck Town Center
places.description: A compact historic center with cafés, bakeries, small shops, and quiet town life.

places.name: General Patton Memorial Museum
places.description: A museum dedicated to WWII history and General Patton, located near the town center.

hidden_gems.name: Quiet Sauer Bend Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: A serene riverside viewpoint perfect for photography and peaceful moments.

hidden_gems.name: Halen Riverside Bridge Path
hidden_gems.description: A lesser-known small walking area with trees and river views.

hidden_gems.name: Old Town Back Streets
hidden_gems.description: Small quiet back streets offering authentic small-town character.

ideas: 🌇 Warm sunset colors over the valley.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚆 Ettelbruck is a major rail hub for northern Luxembourg — trains are free nationwide.
🚌 Free local and regional buses connect the town with nearby villages.
🚶 The town center and riverside area are fully walkable.
📱 Use the Mobiliteit app for real-time schedules.
